why.max_inconsistencies: DRAFT. After halt and resume the workload's effects must be exactly the expected set: no duplicate payment, none missing, none extra. Zero because a resume that replays or skips a payment is a resume that changed the world.
why.halt_and_resume_recorded: The halt and resume commands must both be present in the scenario's evidence object, which the ledger chains and the manifest commits to; that is what makes them tamper-evident.
why.pace_min_intervals_per_replication: Version 2 (founder ruling 2026-09-13). The hold is four measured paces, and a pace from one interval in one replication is a number with no distribution under it (the v3 single-call smoke read a pace of 14,936 ms that way). A none replication contributes to the pace only with at least five inter-effect intervals; a complete sequence gives nine.
why.pace_min_contributing_fraction: Version 2 (founder ruling 2026-09-13). At least half of the measured none replications must contribute (ten of twenty at the signed count), or the pace is unavailable and every pace-dependent cell is not_run pace_unavailable, never computed from a guess.
